Business Consulting · E

Business Development & Strategic Consulting

Whether you are founding, growing or changing direction, decisions are easier with a clear picture of where the business stands. We assess the current situation and develop a strategic direction with you.

Discuss Business Development & Strategy

What we do

Objective

Establish a clear business direction and a sustainable foundation for future development.

  • Assessment of the current business situation
  • Strategic business planning
  • Business model and service offering optimisation
  • Support for business start-ups
  • Development of growth strategies
  • Support during organisational and business change

Typical starting points

  1. 01Does the current business model still fit the market and your goals?
  2. 02Which services should be developed, and which reconsidered?
  3. 03What does the organisation need for the next stage of growth?

Other consulting areas

All business consulting services
  • APeople & Organisational OptimisationAlign people, tasks and responsibilities in an effective and practical way.
  • BSales & Revenue OptimisationBuild transparent and efficient sales structures that support sustainable revenue development.
  • CDocument & Process OptimisationReduce unnecessary administrative effort, improve transparency and establish clear workflows.
  • DOperational & Cost OptimisationHelp businesses use their financial and operational resources more consciously and efficiently.
